integrity: All finite enumerations, mod-two rank computations, component tests, and beat-point deletions are reconstructed and checked by the packaged standalone verifier. Classical comparison uses established finite-space mapping and order-complex theorems.
scientific_limitations: The exact statement concerns the Cianci--Ottina model P_2^2 and the four-point minimal circle. It does not assert the same component cardinalities for all finite RP2 models, based mapping spaces, or arbitrary sources.
title: The four-point finite circle realizes both homotopy classes into a minimal projective plane
